facts.F1: ADO Story 6504: Choose whether a Feature without children gets an inferred size. Today a Feature with no child Work Items is sized by the Portfolio's Default Feature Size and that count is spread across the teams (e.g. '0 of 4'); some users read it as data from the tracker. Want a setting: Infer (today's behaviour, clearly labelled as an assumption wherever the count shows) or Disable (no inferred count; the Feature shows no remaining work and says it has no child Work Items yet). Open: what a forecast does for such a Feature when inference is off. Source: customer feedback 2026-11-02 ('No guessing when an item has no children ... I'd rather see nothing, or a clear label saying it's an assumption'). Maintainer skipped DISCOVER and DIVERGE explicitly on 2026-11-25; stand-alone Story, no parent Epic.

facts.F68: Absent field: PortfolioSettingDto.InfersDefaultFeatureSize is bool? (the IgnoreDependencies precedent) and PortfolioExtensions keeps the stored value when it is absent, so an older UI, script or CLI payload cannot switch it off. A new Portfolio holds true. The column is additive: NOT NULL with default true for existing rows, generated by Create-Migration.ps1 for Sqlite and Postgres. The wire name is infersDefaultFeatureSize. Rejected: JsonRequired (turns every older payload into a 400), plain bool (missing field would mean false, which silently turns sizing off).
facts.F69: Feature read model: Feature gains a derived read-only property HasNoChildWorkItemsYet (not Done, no child Work Items, not using the default size), exposed on FeatureDto and FeatureListRowDto and decoded by the frontend Feature model. It is true exactly when the switch is off for a childless Feature, so the note cannot claim a cause that is false and the frontend holds no copy of the rule. This replaces the DISCUSS expectation that the Feature payload gains nothing. Rejected: deriving it in the frontend from total work (a second copy of the rule that mislabels a Feature not yet refreshed), reading the Portfolio setting in the lists (the Team list and the timeline hold no Portfolio setting, and a Feature may sit in several Portfolios).

facts.F71: Owner: Portfolio owns the sizing rule. It gains one setting, InfersDefaultFeatureSize (bool, true by default), and its two existing selectors GetFeaturesToExtrapolate and GetFeaturesToOverrideWithDefaultSize return no Feature when the setting is off. WorkItemService.UpdateRemainingWorkForPortfolio is unchanged: with both selections empty it neither clears real children nor extrapolates, so a childless not-Done Feature keeps no FeatureWork and IsUsingDefaultFeatureSize stays false (size 0). The percentile and estimate-field helpers are then never reached. Rejected: a branch in WorkItemService (transaction script over Portfolio data), a second sizing strategy object (one boolean, no second implementation).
facts.F72: Propagation (changes the proposed domain event): no new event and no inline call. Remaining work is recomputed from stored data in every Portfolio and Team refresh cycle (WorkItemService.UpdateFeaturesForPortfolio and UpdateWorkItemsForTeam), exactly as it is for Default Feature Size today; Forecasting already reacts to PortfolioFeaturesRefreshed. A settings save therefore takes effect on the next refresh cycle, not at the click. The setting is classified Cost.Nothing in FetchShapingPropertyGuardTest: it shapes no fetch. Rejected: a PortfolioSettingsChanged event that forces recalculation (new edge and handler for a rule the cycle already re-evaluates; the existing sizing settings have no such event).
facts.F73: Context map (ADR-270): the setting is Portfolio configuration, owned by Organisation set-up with the other connection-default style sizing settings; the rule is applied inside Work Items (WorkItemService refresh over Portfolio.Features); Forecasting is unchanged and reads the resulting size through the existing Feature refresh event. No new context and no new edge. One new glossary term, default Feature sizing (the on/off switch for inferring a size, distinct from default Feature size, the number); the term is recorded in the ADR-270 glossary and ARCHITECTURE.md section 4 by slice S1. UI surface (ADR-271): the Advanced tab of the Portfolio settings, inside the existing Default Feature Size group; the note surfaces on existing Feature lists and the Delivery timeline.

facts.F75: Formal verification mapping: the sizing rule is a finite pure total function of switch, Done, child count, override membership and estimate. Checker: Quint 0.33.1 (state model, run and bounded verify with behavioral mutants), because the claims are safety and exclusion only. Agda is not needed (no proof beyond the finite domain). TLA+/TLC is not needed (no temporal or fairness claim; see liveness closure). Property-based testing: not applied, because the domain is finite and fully covered by native table-style example cases (closed-world falsifier gate). Types: native bool plus a guarded selector; the invalid combination off-and-using-default is made unrepresentable by the selectors returning no Feature, and is not enforced by the type system (C# runtime checker only).
